messages:
maya: heads up — gitops reconcile for gpu-pool-us-west failed, terraform apply blocked by remote state lock in DynamoDB. LockID `3c8f9a2b-zzzz` present for >45m. pods can't scale, 6 pending GPU requests. anyone on this?
deploybot: gitops-controller: reconcile failed for cluster/gpu-pool-us-west (commit sha abc123). terraform apply timed out waiting for lock.
sam: can you paste the lock id from the dynamo row? if there's no active apply we can try `terraform force-unlock 3c8f9a2b-zzzz` from a safe workstation.
oliver: worth checking gitops-controller logs to see if it spawned a duplicate apply (we had a state-split last month that left two workspace keys for some resources). also check if the state key changed during the import; that can leave a dangling lock.
maya: LockID is the one above. I see owner=fluxcd, info field shows started_by=gitops-controller, started_at=2026-03-18T11:02:07Z. No active apply in CI.
anya: first check TTL on the dynamo entry: `aws dynamodb get-item --table-name tf-state-locks --key '{"LockID":{"S":"3c8f9a2b-zzzz"}}'` look at LastUpdate and TTL attribute. If TTL hasn't expired and there's no in-flight apply, `terraform force-unlock` is the least invasive. If that fails, we can remove the item via `aws dynamodb delete-item` as last resort.
jun: also, workload-wise, we should temporary-shift pending jobs to the eu-gpu pool to avoid customer impact. I'll open a quick routing rule: `kubectl annotate ns/ai workload-routing=eu-temp -n infra` and patch the provisioner if needed.
sam: agree — do force-unlock first. when you run it, include the exact LockID string from the table.
maya: running `terraform force-unlock 3c8f9a2b-zzzz` now from bastion (working dir uses same backend config).
maya: returned: "Force-unlocked lock 3c8f9a2b-zzzz". re-triggering flux reconcile.
deploybot: reconcile queued -> started for gpu-pool-us-west (commit abc123).
oliver: check `kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=gpu-provisioner` for pending -> should start scheduling once state is free.
maya: pods are moving to Running, 4/6 pending cleared, backlog draining.
jun: I'll start the temporary routing rollback after we confirm all pending jobs cleared.
anya: add a short runbook note: when force-unlocking, always check dynamo item owner/lastupdate and confirm no apply in CI. Also capture the lock TTL so we can avoid manual deletes next time.
sam: follow-up: file a quick postmortem comment in the infra board about the state-key drift risk from the import flow. we need a small automation to verify single canonical state key after any state move.
maya: noted. I'll post a short incident entry and assign to eng-infra. For now GPU capacity restored and pipeline green. :tada:
